audience: event teams who manage invitations, guests and attendance in Evenium

useCases.title: See who has not answered an invitation
useCases.text: The AI lists the guests of an event by registration status, such as unanswered, confirmed or declined, with name, email and company, so you know whom to remind.

useCases.title: Update a guest's status after an email reply
useCases.text: The AI reads the guest's current status and then sets it, for example to confirmed or declined. Changing the status can start the event's own workflows in Evenium.

useCases.title: Mark attendance after the event
useCases.text: The AI sets guests to present or no-show after check-in, so your attendance numbers are ready the same day.

useCases.title: Invite people to an event
useCases.text: The AI searches the address book, creates a missing contact and invites the person to an event as a guest. Invitation emails may follow Evenium's rules for that event.

useCases.title: Review a session's registrations
useCases.text: The AI lists the sessions and workshops of an event and the registrations to one session with their status and attendance.

useCases.title: Check hotel bookings for guests
useCases.text: The AI lists the hotels of an event and the room bookings of a guest with check-in and check-out dates, on accounts where hotels are available.
